redfin.remarks: TWO LEVELS . TWO FULL KITCHENS . MULTIPLE PRIVATE ENTRANCES . SOUTH OF THE BOULEVARD! Multiple private entrances provide wonderful separation and versatility. Additional highlights include a 2-car garage and oversized driveway with ample parking. Ideally located near Ventura Boulevard, major studios, dining, shopping and entertainment, and within the Carpenter Community Charter School area (subject to enrollment availability).
